resources.string: Nothing to show yet.\nThe data is updated automatically.
Pick an incident or roadworks entry to see its details here.

Contains Traffic Scotland data (DATEX II feeds: unplanned events and current roadworks).

Data is downloaded when the app starts and then every hour. If there is no connection, the last downloaded data is shown.

Icons: drawn for this app by Haziq Ayaan Ahmad (own work).
